shared_hypothesis: The seed-0 canonical-E4 tail-safe advantage is a reproducible auxiliary-regularization effect with a consistent worst-experiment direction.
predicted_signature: Tail-safe minus zero auxiliary preserves positive mean OOD or worst-experiment accuracy at epochs 30 and 60 with no more than two ID points lost.
alternative_explanation: The seed-0 difference is checkpoint noise or generic regularization that exact dense objective controls can explain.
falsifier: Either fresh seed loses both mean and worst direction at the locked final milestone, ID loss exceeds two points, or exact dense objective controls reproduce the effect.
pruning_rule: At epoch 10 retain Pareto tradeoffs because delayed emergence is predeclared; at epoch 30 prune a tail-safe arm only if dominated on OOD validation, ID retention, worst-experiment accuracy, and mechanism signature; no epoch90 without the locked final gate.
checkpoint_policy: save exact primary comparator checkpoints at epochs 10, 30, and 60
result_budget: four final JSONs, twelve milestone rows, twelve checkpoints, four mechanism rows, four W&B runs, and four checksum manifests
